maria_sales: Hey team — cust wants to keep their HSM for key custody but run Redwood in our hosted tier. They asked if we can front their HSM with a key-proxy pattern so we never persist raw keys. Thoughts?

omar_se: Yep that's doable via envelope encryption + our KMS proxy. We do the wrapping/unwrapping on the fly and never store the unwrapped key on disk.

alice_security: Important Q: how frequently do they want rotation? Auditors asking for 15m rotation windows for KEKs. That's pretty aggressive.

maria_sales: They said "15m would be ideal, but 1h is acceptable if there are perf tradeoffs." Also want audit logs for every unwrap request forwarded to their HSM.

omar_se: Two tradeoffs to call out: (1) latency — proxy adds a roundtrip to HSM on first use after rotation, (2) cost — HSM operations (unwrap/wrap) may be billable per-op by vendor. We can cache KEK-wrapped intermediate for N minutes to amortize.

raj_ops: Re: caching: we can keep a short in-memory cache of the decrypted CEK (cache TTL configurable). If rotation occurs we invalidate. For 15m rotation, set TTL <= rotation window. That reduces HSM ops but means every rotate invalidates caches across nodes.

alice_security: Audit requirement: they want per-request correlation id and a signed proof from HSM on unwraps. We can forward their request id and store HSM returned metadata in our audit logs. Need legal signoff for metadata retention.

maria_sales: Pricing question from procurement: will proxy'ing to customer HSM increase hosted seat price or be an add-on? They mentioned charging back HSM vendor fees.

omar_se: Recommend pricing model: host-side: + per-unwrap request surcharge (to pass through HSM op costs) OR flat monthly addon for managed key-proxy. Ops overhead too (support SLA).

raj_ops: For SLA — if customer HSM latency spikes we need a fallback. Option A: automatic fallback to a Redwood-managed key variant (requires customer consent + config). Option B: circuit-breaker that returns 503 and route to degraded model. Which does the customer prefer?

maria_sales: Customer prefers no silent fallback to our keys — compliance disallows it. They'll accept a configured warm-standby if we log explicit approvals via the console.

alice_security: Ok addendum: must support key version pinning and replay-protection for old CEKs. Also KMS rotation policy must be auditable for e-discovery.

omar_se: Example config snippet we discussed:

```
kms:
  mode: proxy
  proxy:
    hsm_endpoint: "https://customer-hsm.example"
    wrap_cache_ttl_seconds: 300
    rotation_grace_seconds: 30
    audit_forwarding: true
```

omitted: we won't store unwrapped_key: true

raj_ops: Ops tasks: 1) confirm HSM vendor API (unwrap/wrap + signed attestations), 2) test 15m rotation with cache TTL 300s, 3) measure p95 latency impact, 4) create billing SKU.

maria_sales: I'll schedule a joint call with customer + their crypto team next Tue. Also they asked for a short tradeoff doc we can send to procurement. Can someone draft a 1-pager?

omar_se: I'll draft the architecture + perf/latency bullets. Will include bench numbers from our lab for proxying to CloudHSM.

alice_security: I'll add the security checklist + retention notes.

maria_sales: Perfect — thx. tagging @deploy-bot to create a runbook ticket.

raj_ops: I'll kick off a PoC cluster and share results in this thread.

maria_sales: Great — keep the updates short, customer wants timeline and clear blockers. :thumbsup:
